meta: How hair and nail salons can use AI: customers book and forget, the chair sits empty, and AI can help with the messages.

muc.title: Customers book and forget
muc.text: Hair and nail salons often have customers who book and then forget, leaving a chair empty all afternoon. AI can help with the messages.

muc.title: Confirmation messages
muc.text: Ask AI for a short template to confirm bookings and remind customers a day before, with the time and how to reschedule.

muc.title: Aftercare instructions
muc.text: Ask AI to write care tips after coloring, perming or gel nails, then the owner edits them from experience.

muc.title: Remove customer numbers
muc.text: Before pasting old messages into AI, delete customers' names and phone numbers.

muc.title: Three reminder templates
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for three appointment reminder templates for your salon, then save them as quick replies.

thu: Ask a chatbot for three appointment reminder templates for your salon, then save them as quick replies.
